motion.name: ease-out

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Migration target replacing the banned --ease-spring elastic curve. Apply to card hover lift, badge hover, icon-link hover.

motion.name: ease-glitch
motion.purpose: Glitch RGB-split animation timing function. Paired with steps(1) for digital chunkiness.

motion.name: duration-glitch
motion.purpose: RGB-split animation total length. Short enough to feel like a hiccup, not an effect.

narrative.overview:
Hacker register without cosplay. The interface reads like a terminal someone showed you for thirty seconds before closing it — crimson accents used sparingly, a near-black canvas with warm undertone, mono labels marking instruments, glitch as a fingerprint rather than a theme. The visual vocabulary is borrowed from operations-room HUDs and decommissioned hardware: scanlines, telemetry markers, RGB-split fringe, woven-canvas background texture. Restraint is the load-bearing choice. The crimson does not shout because it does not need to.

This system rejects every flavor of category default. Not generic SaaS-portfolio, not Awwwards motion reel, not designer-editorial, not crypto / neon-on-black hacker cliché. The fingerprint sits one level upstream of the cliché — hacker-coded, not hacker-cosplay.

Density is medium-low: confident negative space anchors every section. Typographic energy comes from Orbitron's angular display weight against Space Grotesk's calm body and JetBrains Mono's instrumental labels. Crimson appears only at the points where attention is earned.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with oxide-tinted neutrals, crimson accent ≤10% of any screen
Three-font system: Orbitron display, Space Grotesk body, JetBrains Mono instruments
Scanlines and CRT noise as ambient atmosphere, not decoration
RGB-split glitch is opt-in (data-text attribute), hover-triggered, reduced-motion respected
Telemetry-style markers (mono labels, → indicators, scroll progress bar) signal the page is running, not just rendered
Flat-by-default surfaces with tonal layering for depth
Motion is restrained: state transitions, no choreography

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Crimson is the only accent that touches body content. Blue, green, and yellow are role-locked: blue is the latest-post shadow + glitch, green is status, yellow is reserved. Mixing two accents in the same component is forbidden.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals should carry a faint crimson temperature (chroma ~0.005 toward hue 25), not be pure black or pure cool-gray. Current tokens are pure neutral hex; the migration target is OKLCH with brand-hue chroma.

rules.name: The Crimson Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Crimson covers ≤10% of any rendered viewport. If a screen requires more crimson, the screen is wrong — reduce by removing, not by re-toning.

rules.name: The Three-Font Rule
rules.body: Orbitron for identity, Space Grotesk for content, JetBrains Mono for telemetry. A fourth font is prohibited. Inter is explicitly banned.

rules.name: The Mono-as-Instrument Rule
rules.body: Mono is never used for prose. Mono labels mark sections, dates, tags, telemetry — anything the system measures or names.

rules.name: The Section-Label Pair Rule
rules.body: Every Title is preceded by a mono section-label. The pair is a fingerprint of the system; do not use a Title without one, or a section-label without a Title.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, badges, and surfaces sit flat. Depth only appears when the user reaches toward an element — hover, focus, active.

rules.name: The Asymmetric Glow Rule
rules.body: The hero 'latest post' card carries crimson + electric-blue shadow as its signature. Symmetric glow on both sides flattens the effect; preserve the left-crimson / right-blue split.

dos: Do lead every section with a mono section-label paired with an Orbitron Title.
Do keep crimson on ≤10% of any rendered viewport.
Do lift surfaces tonally (bg → surface → surface-raised) instead of casting ambient shadow.
Do use JetBrains Mono only for telemetry: labels, dates, tags, copyright, the logo separator.
Do preserve the asymmetric crimson + electric-blue glow on the hero 'latest post' card.
Do make every effect opt-in. Glitch via data-text, scanlines via .scanlines class.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce everywhere motion exists.
Do target 44×44px minimum for touch targets.
Do migrate neutrals from pure hex to OKLCH with brand-hue chroma.
Do use ease-out exponential curves (ease-out-quart, quint, expo) for motion.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + linear-gradient) anywhere.
Don't use elastic / overshoot easing. The current --ease-spring token is forbidden.
Don't ship the hero-metric template (big number + small label + supporting stats + divider).
Don't add a fourth font. Three is the system. Inter is explicitly banned.
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px as a colored accent on cards or callouts.
Don't introduce identical card grids (icon + heading + text repeated endlessly).
Don't rely on backdrop-filter blur for decoration.
Don't use neon green, Matrix rain, skull motifs, or any crypto-hacker cliché.
Don't use Inter, serif display, cream backgrounds, or pastel-on-white patterns.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left, margin). Animate transform and opacity only.
Don't introduce hard-coded color literals in component CSS. Use tokens.
